topic: Avoiding a car title loan vs losing the car (Cliff vs Marlene)

scenes.narration: A five hundred dollar title loan cost one driver her entire paid off car. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a car being towed away stamped REPOSSESSED, comic burst banner reads TITLE LOST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cliff and Marlene both need five hundred dollars fast for an emergency.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man cliff and woman marlene each looking worried at a bill stamped URGENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A title loan shop offers cash against their fully paid off cars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a neon storefront labeled TITLE LOANS, a clerk waving cash beside a car, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marlene hands over her car title for quick cash that day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman marlene handing a clerk a document labeled CAR TITLE, receiving a small stack of cash, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The loan hides a three hundred percent yearly interest rate.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a contract with a huge red number stamped THREE HUNDRED PERCENT APR, woman marlene squinting at fine print, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cliff says no and asks his credit union for a small loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man cliff at a credit union desk shaking hands, a sign reads SMALL DOLLAR LOAN LOW RATE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He gets the same five hundred at a fair affordable rate.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man cliff holding a loan paper with a highlighted line reading LOW FIXED RATE, calm and relieved, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cliff keeps his car title safely in his own glovebox.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man cliff tucking a document labeled CAR TITLE into his car glovebox, smiling, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marlene falls one payment behind and the lender repossesses her car.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a tow truck hauling away woman marlene's car, she watches in shock, comic banner reads REPOSSESSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She loses her ride to work and still owes the balance.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman marlene standing at an empty parking spot, a bill in hand stamped STILL OWED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cliff pays his small loan off and keeps driving stress free.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man cliff driving his own car happily, a paper on the seat stamped PAID OFF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Never trade your car title for fast cash, find a credit union. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads AVOID TITLE LOANS, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
